stem: A Schedule II prescription is issued for a resident of a long-term-care facility and is being partially filled under the federal LTCF pathway. Assuming the prescription is not discontinued, how long may partial fillings continue from the issue date under this special rule?

explanation.core_reasoning: Schedule II prescriptions for LTCF residents or terminally ill patients may be partially filled under the special federal framework for up to 60 days from issue unless discontinued sooner.

choice_analysis.A: That clock belongs to a different C-II partial-fill situation.
choice_analysis.B: That is an adjacent emergency-follow-up period.
choice_analysis.C: That is not the federal LTCF/terminal partial-fill endpoint.
choice_analysis.D: The special pathway permits partial filling for up to 60 days from issue.
choice_analysis.E: That resembles a III/IV refill framework.

related_facts: This is separate from stock-shortage and patient-requested partial-fill rules.

reasoning_steps: Identify the LTCF special partial-fill pathway
